scientific_conclusion: The observables match additive-energy manifestations when claims are limited to recorded pause energy and spectral structure.
Median AC-RMS dBFS, IQR, level contrast, spectral flatness, and harmonic-comb prominence measure their stated observables.
Canonical intervals, no duplicate speech erosion, winner-consistent hum support, media hashes, and ledger reconstruction pass.
Gain equivariance/invariance, polarity, DC, time shift, resampling, and codec behavior match the contracts.
Noise, speech/pause factorial, amplitude modulation, spectral type, and hum-comb doses produce the expected responses.
Competing-speech identity is unresolved and exact low-F0 periodic sources can mimic 50/60-Hz comb structure.
Availability, floor censoring, window counts, support tiers, count-matched hum calibration, and missingness are explicit.
Most features are stable when supported; pause IQR and hum are more support-sensitive, and hum can be intermittent.
Units, orientation, nonordinal features, quality-direction limits, and failure modes are explicitly documented.
Each feature is labeled as established primitive plus study-specific aggregation or targeted proxy; no scalar or gate is authorized.
